scenes.headline: What a hexagon with a colour ramp buys a splat
scenes.sub: Hexels, read from the paper and the repo
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Waggle! Today: how one soft hexagon with a colour ramp can stand in for several Gaussians.

scenes.text: Swap the Gaussian in a flat surfel for a soft hexagon that carries a colour ramp, so one primitive covers more surface.
scenes.say: The new idea is the primitive. A soft hexagon with a colour ramp, so one patch covers more surface than one Gaussian.

steps.say: Each pixel's ray hits the hexel's plane. The hit is exact, not a flat approximation.
That gives local coordinates u and v, in the patch's own frame.
A soft hexagon turns them into a weight. Beta sets how sharp the edge is.
The colour ramp gives a colour at that point. Weight and colour blend front to back, as in two D G S.

scenes.title: A Gaussian surfel against a hexel

left.title: Gaussian surfel
left.say: A Gaussian surfel has a long tail, one colour, and fifty-eight floats.

right.title: Hexel
right.say: A hexel has a cut-off, a colour ramp, and twenty floats. At equal memory that is almost three times as many primitives.

scenes.title: The colour ramp
scenes.text: c = c0 + u gu + v gv

parts.say: c zero is the base colour at the centre.

parts.note: a slope along each local axis
parts.say: Two gradients add a slope along each local axis.
So colour varies smoothly across the face, with nine numbers.

scenes.label: hexel model trained on the iPad
scenes.say: On the iPad, the six thousand hexel model is half a mebibyte. The rest of the process is the app and the images.

scenes.text: The sharp edge carries the gain over a Gaussian; the six sides barely matter, and the ramp helps only with few primitives.
scenes.say: What I found: the sharp edge carries the gain over a Gaussian. The six sides barely matter, and the ramp helps only with few primitives.

recap: A hexel is a soft hexagon with a colour ramp.
In my toys the sharp edge did most.
scenes.say: A hexel is a soft hexagon with a colour ramp, in twenty floats. In my toys the sharp edge did most of the work.
